articles.title: BNB Chain details new layer-1 for trading, private finance and AI
articles.description: The proposed network will operate alongside BNB Smart Chain and retain BNB as its native token, with a public testnet targeted for the first quarter of 2027.

articles.title: Binance completes withdrawal recovery four weeks after $6.3B hack
articles.description: The announcement concludes a phased withdrawal recovery that began on Nov. 1, when Binance restored Bitcoin withdrawals following the record crypto theft.

articles.title: UK is ‘getting it wrong’ on DeFi regulation, says Coinbase

articles.title: Japan weighs tighter oversight of DeFi, self-custodial wallets
articles.description: Japan’s financial regulator is exploring measures to curb illicit finance risks, including potential restrictions on access to DeFi services.

articles.title: Crypto on notice as hawkish Fed risks December ‘meltdown’

articles.title: Nasdaq exec pushes for common EU rules on tokenized securities

articles.title: Sky proposes emergency vote on $25M transfer amid liquidity stress
